title: AI Product Ad Templates for Photos and Videos | AIVideosUGC
description: Find product ad templates for a photo or a short video. Pick a style, add one product photo, and get a new file for your store or a social post.
h1: Product Ad Templates: Pick a Look, Rebuild It, Post It
lead: Find a product ad template you like, add the item you sell, and get a spoken ad. The words, the voice, the captions, and a presenter made by the tool come with it. The presenter is not a real customer. You do not type instructions.
card: Ready-made layouts for product pictures and short clips. Add your photo and download the next file.

faq.q: What is a product ad template?
faq.a: It is a ready layout for a product picture or a short spoken clip. You add your item and get a script, a spoken voice, captions, and a presenter made by the tool. You are not hiring a real person to film it.

faq.q: How does a product ad template work?
faq.a: Open a template, upload a photo or paste a product link, and check the preview. The script, the voice, and the presenter are filled in. The presenter is made by the tool, not a real customer. Download or post when the item and the words look right.

faq.q: Why use a template instead of filming a creator?
faq.a: You skip hiring a person and renting a studio. You can make another version, or switch the language. Credits are what you spend. You see the cost before you start.
Online shops, marketers, and agencies. You may need a store photo, a photo for social, or a short spoken clip. You already have a product photo or a product link.

faq.q: Can a beginner use these templates?
faq.a: Yes. You do not need editing experience. Pick a template and add a photo. In the editor on this page, you can shorten the clip, fix the captions, or add a song.

Use the category buttons on the examples. Skincare sits under Beauty & Personal Care. Clothing, Apparel, Food & Beverage, and Footwear each have a button. So do Jewelry & Accessories, Tech & Electronics, and Health & Fitness. Accessories, Pet, Sports & Gym, and Apps have buttons too. Home layouts, such as a tidy-room clip, are in the template gallery on this page.

faq.q: Can I upload my own photos and clips?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a product photo or a clip you are allowed to use, or paste a product link. The item in the file should be yours. A clear, full view is easier to check.

faq.q: Which platforms are these templates made for?
faq.a: Clip templates fit TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Shapes are a tall phone video (9:16), a square (1:1), a wide video (16:9), a slightly wide 4:3, or a tall 3:4. Picture templates are square. Send a finished file to TikTok or Meta, or download it and post it yourself. Meta is Facebook and Instagram.

No. Making a file spends credits. Credits are what your plan uses for each photo or video. You see the cost before you start. If the work fails, the credits come back. Prices are on the [pricing page](page:pricing).

faq.q: Can I use the download in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Finished photos and clips can be used in paid ads. They have no watermark, which means no logo on the file. You are still responsible for what the ad says, the price, and the offer.

faq.q: Why use a template instead of a blank page?
faq.a: A template already has a scene, a script, a voice, and a presenter made by the tool. You spend your time on the product and the offer.
